words:
雲[くも] — cloud — बादल
雨雲[あまぐも] — rain cloud — पानी पर्ने बादल
入道雲[にゅうどうぐも] — thundercloud — गर्जने बादल
example: 空[そら]に 白[しろ]い 雲[くも]が 浮[う]かんでいる。
example_en: White clouds are floating in the sky.
component: 雨 + 云 (rain vapor gathering into a cloud)
confusable: 曇 (くも・る) = 日 + 雲; 電 (でん) and 雪 (ゆき) share the 雨 top
tags: N3 kanji batch7 vocab_linked kanji_day55 noun

words:
曇[くも]る — to become cloudy — बादल लाग्नु
曇[くも]り — cloudy weather — बादल लागेको
曇天[どんてん] — overcast sky — बादलमय आकाश
example: 明日[あした]は 曇[くも]りのち 雨[あめ]でしょう。
example_en: Tomorrow will be cloudy, then rainy.
example_ne: भोलि बादल लागेर पछि पानी पर्ला।
component: 日 + 雲 (the sun blocked behind a thick cloud)
confusable: 雲 (くも, the cloud itself) vs 曇り (the cloudy state)
disc_front: Which kanji is the weather 'cloudy'? 明日は＿り
disc_note: 曇 has 日 on top of 雲 — the sun hidden, i.e. the weather. 雲 alone is the cloud object.
tags: N3 kanji batch7 vocab_linked kanji_day55 verb confusable

words:

words:

words:

words:

危機[きき] — crisis — संकट

component: ⺈ + 厂 + 卩 (a person kneeling precariously at the edge of a cliff)

words:
危険[きけん] — danger — खतरा
保険[ほけん] — insurance — बिमा
冒険[ぼうけん] — adventure — साहसिक यात्रा
険[けわ]しい — steep; harsh (expression) — भिरालो; कठोर
example: 会社[かいしゃ]の 健康[けんこう] 保険[ほけん]に 入[はい]っている。
example_en: I'm enrolled in the company health insurance.
component: 阝 + 㑒 (a rugged mountain pass full of steep danger)
confusable: 験 (けん) = 馬 + 㑒; 検 (けん) = 木 + 㑒 — all three read けん
disc_front: Which kanji is in 保険 (insurance)? 保＿
disc_note: 険 has 阝 on the left — danger, risk (危険, 保険). 検 has 木 — inspection (検査). 験 has 馬 — 試験.
tags: N3 kanji batch7 vocab_linked kanji_day56 noun confusable

words:

保存[ほぞん] — preservation, saving — सुरक्षित राख्नु
